tickets.title: Add Apple Pay support at checkout
tickets.description: Customers on iOS Safari can pay with Apple Pay. Uses Stripe Payment Request API. Merchant validation endpoint added to checkout-service.

tickets.title: Fix duplicate charge when user double-clicks Pay
tickets.description: Added idempotency key to charge requests so a repeated click within 5 seconds no longer creates a second charge.

tickets.title: Upgrade TLS config to disable TLS 1.0/1.1
tickets.description: Gateway now only accepts TLS 1.2+. Clients on older TLS will fail to connect.

tickets.title: Rename /v1/payments to /v2/payments
tickets.description: v1 endpoint removed. Response field 'amt' renamed to 'amount'. Integrators must update before upgrading.

tickets.title: Faster invoice PDF generation
tickets.description: Switched renderer to a cached template; average generation time reduced from 4.2s to 1.1s.

tickets.title: Refactor payment module to use dependency injection
tickets.description: No functional change. Prepares for provider plug-ins.

tickets.title: Receipts email shows wrong currency symbol for JPY
tickets.description: JPY amounts were shown with a $ sign in receipt emails. Now uses the ISO currency symbol.

tickets.title: Export transactions as CSV
tickets.description: Finance users can download filtered transaction lists as CSV from the dashboard (max 50,000 rows).
